title: nan
authors: Kilic C.; Gutierrez E.; Gross J.N.
key_contribution: Presents a Decentralized Extended Kalman Filter (DEKF) multi-robot cooperative localization method integrating IMU, UWB, odometer, and Zero Velocity Updates (ZUPT) in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
